title: Extended Q4: constant-core and int8-quantized persistent controls on the trained Q4 checkpoints
motivation: The November 2026 review flagged two missing controls in the Q4 design: (a) a fitted constant-core arm, separating 'conditioning helps' from 'any modulation of the frozen factors helps', and (b) an int8-quantized persistent baseline, testing whether quantization alone recovers the storage/latency point the conditional arms target. This document versions the exact protocol and thresholds BEFORE execution; it is evidence-class pre-registration, not a prediction.

source_run.checkpoints: the four trained seeds (2026-2029) of the 2026-11-13 matched run, retained on the measurement host
source_run.shared_protocol: all arms reuse the frozen closing protocol: layer 16 FFN of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, d=1536, m=8960, fp32 training, 5000 steps, lr 2e-4, batch 1, S=128, ranks 384/401, seeds 2026-2029, frozen train/dev/test split (sha256 in data/quality/manifest.json)

constant_core_r384.definition: Fit per-output-column constant scales c* on the trained token_diag_core_r384 checkpoint's calibration activations (the Proposition-1 constant, same least-squares fit as the CPU audits), then evaluate the scaled persistent factors. No new training: this is a post-hoc control on the trained artifact.
constant_core_r384.purpose: separates 'learned conditioning signal' from 'any static rescaling of the frozen factors'

persistent_r384_int8.definition: The trained persistent_low_rank_r384 checkpoint with both factors quantized to int8 per-output-channel (per-column of V, per-column of U) with fp32 scales computed from calibration activations; dequantize-on-read or int8-compute+fp32-accumulate per the host's fastest correct path; the unquantized persistent_r384 arm is the reference.
persistent_r384_int8.storage: factors at 1 byte/element + fp32 per-channel scales (documenting the storage point the conditional arms compete with)
persistent_r384_int8.purpose: tests whether quantization alone reaches the conditional arms' quality at lower storage, bounding the conditional arms' advantage to the fp16-vs-int8 gap

quality.metric: relative MSE on the frozen dev split (and held-out test split for the final report), identical batches and batches-count as the Q4 run (128 eval batches), fp32 evaluation of the dequantized/scaled outputs
quality.calibration: constant scales and int8 ranges fit on the same calibration batches for all arms; no test data touched for fitting

latency.metric: median single-layer latency ms at batch 1, S=128, fp16 compute (int8 arm at int8 where the path supports it, fp16 otherwise, recorded per-seed which path ran), same timing loop as the Q4 benchmark (warmup + 100 timed iterations, median)
latency.boundary: single-layer, batch 1, one Ascend 910B2 device; not end-to-end decode

quality_non_inferiority.statement: the constant-core arm and the int8 arm are each reported against persistent_r384 with the per-seed paired difference and its sign
quality_non_inferiority.decision_rule: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: no superiority or non-inferiority claim is promoted from these four seeds; intervals are descriptive per the paper's standing policy

latency_gate.int8_arm: recorded; no gate (the int8 arm is a control, not a proposal)
latency_gate.note: the >=20% latency gate remains attached only to the compiled tile-local realization (TILE_GATE in experiments/verify_tile_apply_benchmark.py)

pre_registered_thresholds.failure_policy: a failed or negative outcome is recorded as a first-class result, never promoted; a missing checkpoint or a failed fit aborts that arm with the failure recorded

acceptance_of_execution.gate_script: the executed report must be validated by scripts/audit_journal_evidence.py extended with extended_q4_gate (schema mwg-extended-q4-executed-v1): per-seed rows for both arms, sha256 of the source checkpoints, calibration-batch hashes, and the fitted scale/range tensors' sha256 must all be present
acceptance_of_execution.submission_effect: none by itself: submission_ready is decided by the audit's gate list, not by this run's outcome

claim_boundary: pre-registration only; no measurement has been executed; device access (ASI2) required; thresholds versioned here cannot be relaxed post hoc - any deviation must be recorded as a protocol amendment in a new versioned document, with the original retained
immutable_note: this file, once committed, is the pre-execution record; it must not be edited after execution begins (amendments append new files)
